flows.title: Create an invoice with a discount

steps.title: Open a fresh workspace
steps.text: Open http://localhost:4173/#/reset and verify the Invoices heading is visible.

steps.title: Start a new invoice
steps.text: Click "New invoice". Type "Acme Robotics" in the Client field.

steps.title: Add two line items
steps.text: In line 1 enter item "Design sprint", quantity 2, rate 15000. Click "Add line". In line 2 enter item "QA pass", quantity 1, rate 5000.

steps.title: Apply a discount
steps.text: Set Discount (%) to 10 and click outside the field.

steps.title: Check the totals
steps.text: Verify the summary shows Subtotal ₹35,000, Discount − ₹3,500, GST 18% ₹5,670 and Total ₹37,170.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Click "Save invoice". Verify the page shows "Acme Robotics" with status Draft and Total ₹37,170.

flows.title: Mark a sent invoice as paid

steps.title: Open the invoice list
steps.text: Open http://localhost:4173/#/reset and verify the Invoices heading is visible.

steps.title: Open Kestrel Logistics
steps.text: Click the row for "Kestrel Logistics" (INV-0003). Verify its status is Sent.

steps.title: Record payment
steps.text: Click "Mark as paid". Verify the status badge now reads Paid and the "Mark as paid" button is gone.

steps.title: It sticks in the list
steps.text: Click "Invoices" in the top navigation, choose "Paid" in the status filter, and verify "Kestrel Logistics" is listed.

steps.title: Open the invoice list
steps.text: Open http://localhost:4173/#/reset and verify 4 invoices are listed.

steps.title: Search by client
steps.text: Type "northwind" in the Search client box. Verify exactly 2 rows are shown and both are "Northwind Traders".

steps.title: Narrow by status
steps.text: Choose "Draft" in the status filter. Verify exactly 1 row is shown: INV-0004.

steps.title: No results
steps.text: Clear the search box and type "zzz". Verify the message "No invoices match" is visible.
